summary: Example task backs up the IOS config with ios_config backup: yes.
questions: How do I back up a Cisco IOS config with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Back up Cisco IOS config
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config (ios)
  cisco.ios.ios_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_ios_location
  when: ansible_network_os == 'cisco.ios.ios'
```
